declaration.evidence_label: E-MAX DEVELOPMENT (reused development data; not OOS)
declaration.purpose: freeze the M0-M5 survivors as one strategy, replay it end to end from the frozen source rules, and confirm identity, performance, risk and provenance; no ranking, capacity, breadth, exit or exposure is explored
declaration.disclosure: M6 replays a configuration whose M5 numbers are already published. Every gate below is copied from M0 or M5; none is set or moved with knowledge of the M6 replay. A new variant, threshold or multiplier is a new version, not M6.

dataset.binding: the E-R2 .. M5 development binding, unchanged: minute manifest docs/backtest/strategy_e_candidate/strategy_e_d6_development_tape_v1.json through the symlink view (no glob of the live store)
dataset.prechecks: app.backtest.strategy_e_max.prepare (the E-R3 prechecks: chain, binding, V1 reproduction, attribution, PIT poison) before any return

definition.universe: Trading V1.1 PIT universe sealed at 09:25 ET, unchanged

alpha.rule: premarket_gap > 0 AND premarket_rvol >= 3.0 AND position_in_premarket_range >= 0.8 AND return_0900_0925 > 0

definition.execution_implementation: app.strategy_e_max.capacity.execute(capacity=3): E-D2 entry, E-D3 exit, E-D5 classification, 1/n weights, E-D4 costs, all unmodified
definition.composition: session_exposure = global_multiplier x breadth_multiplier, applied in the M5 order: breadth.scale first, then exposure.apply_global
definition.sizing: equal weight over executable positions: final_weight_i = final_session_exposure / n; normal 3 positions 2/3 each, high-breadth 3 positions 1 each; alpha-strength sizing forbidden

cost.scaling: levered net = exposure x (gross - round-trip cost); cost is notional-proportional

definition.equity: equity_t = equity_(t-1) x (1 + session_return_t) over all 480 sessions, no-trade sessions at 0 (E-D6 equity_stats); MDD from the compounded levered series

pipeline.runner: app.dev.run_strategy_e_max_m6 replays every stage from the prepared source frames; no stage result file is read back as an input

stage_identities.S1_R1_MAX3_X1_1X: trades and daily-returns CSV bytes hash to upstream.stage_artifacts.S1_R1_MAX3_X1_1X
stage_identities.S2_PLUS_B2: trades, daily-returns CSV and the high-breadth exposure map hash to upstream.stage_artifacts.S2_PLUS_B2
stage_identities.S3_PLUS_GLOBAL_2X: trades and daily-returns CSV hash to upstream.stage_artifacts.S3_PLUS_GLOBAL_2X

m5_metric_identity.source: committed strategy_e_max_m5_result_v1.json, variants.E20 (authoritative values; never rounded constants)
m5_metric_identity.rule: each section of the M6 replay, after the canonical JSON round trip, equals the committed M5 section exactly; any difference is analysed and, if unexplained, BLOCKS

independent_checks.record_recompute: each session's scenario return equals the sum over SIZED records of Decimal(final weight) x record net return, within 1e-18 absolute (Decimal rounding of 1/n)
independent_checks.equal_weight: every executable record of a session carries the same weight, equal to final_session_exposure / n
independent_checks.exposure_values: every active session has exposure exactly 2 (normal) or 3 (high breadth)
independent_checks.cost_scaling: for every active session and cost scenario c: (GROSS - c) session return equals exposure x c_bp / 10000 within 1e-18
independent_checks.selection: every selected set is the first min(3, H5) of the R1 order; no NOT_SELECTED candidate is ever executed
independent_checks.breadth_map: high breadth exactly on the sessions where universe_rows >= 100 and h5_rate >= 0.030741

gate.source: M0 selection_rule.eligibility and stop_conditions, M5 catastrophic rule; values verbatim
gate.integrity: E-R3 prechecks PASS, stage identities PASS, independent checks PASS, in-process deterministic, tape and daily inputs unchanged after the run
gate.reproducibility: two runs with identical result digest and byte-identical artifacts

stop_conditions.A: M1-M4 all NO_USEFUL_ENHANCEMENT or skipped (checked from the committed verdicts)
stop_conditions.B: authoritative, decisive at M6: flagged when |MDD_10bp| / |MDD_10bp of E-Base| > CAGR_10bp / CAGR_10bp of E-Base (the M0 literal); E-Base values are read from the committed E-R3 result (COST_10BP cumulative_return and maximum_drawdown; CAGR = (1 + cumulative)^(252/480) - 1). If flagged, M6 cannot PASS
stop_conditions.D: every candidate of two consecutive executed stages below -35% MDD (M5 E15/E20 and M6 E-MAX V1)
stop_conditions.E: no variant outside the M0 budget; M6 declares none

gate.stop_b_diagnostic: also reported against the M5 stage comparator E1 (1.0x, the M2-M5 convention) from the committed M5 result; not decisive, its margin is disclosed

cost_risk_classification.rule: EXECUTION COST SENSITIVITY = HIGH when COST_15BP MDD < -0.35; ELEVATED when only COST_20BP MDD < -0.35; LOW otherwise
cost_risk_classification.verdict_effect: none; the primary gate stays the M0 10 bp contract

tail: top1 / top3 / top5 session share of summed session returns
breadth_dependence: high-breadth sessions, trades, summed PnL and share
normal sessions, trades, summed PnL and share
diagnostics.blocks: E-D6 four blocks: mean, compounded, MDD, trades, positive count
calendar: positive / negative months and quarters, best / worst
2026Q2 and 2026Q3 compounded return and summed-PnL share
drawdown: peak session (first and last at the peak value)
recovery session (first close at or above the peak equity) or OPEN

financing_and_live.label: HISTORICAL DEVELOPMENT CANDIDATE / NOT LIVE-LEVERAGE APPROVED
financing_and_live.note: high-breadth sessions require 3.0x gross exposure; Common Risk V1 allows no leverage

no_further_optimization.rule: M6 is the end of E-MAX V1 development exploration
no_further_optimization.next_evidence: forward / shadow evidence or new untouched historical data, chosen after M6

verdict_labels.PASS: E-MAX-M6 PASS — E-MAX V1 DEVELOPMENT CANDIDATE FROZEN

verdict_rule: BLOCK on any integrity, stage-identity, M5-identity or determinism failure; else FAIL when any economic gate, the MDD ceiling, the concentration guard or an authoritative stop condition fails; else PASS

reproducibility.required: identical result digest and byte-identical runtime artifacts
